method: AI-assisted official HTML re-reading for two near-cutoff records. CUHK department application/FAQ pages returned HTTP 200 through read-only HTTPS after research-tool errors. No application portal/session, submission, independent human review or PDF inspection is claimed.

cohort.decision: Explicit cohort in department body and matching central MA dates retained; stale heading/footer not hidden or used as approval.

dates.lateRule: Rolling review may fill places early; after 31 December 2026 consideration depends on places.
dates.receiptRule: Application, payment and supporting documents due by the deadline; department requests online application plus mailed evidence and accepts two references online or hard copy. Exact current receipt/delivery instructions require confirmation.

fees.decision: No approved or all-in price, no selected PT figure or calculated two-year total, no currency/living-cost or research-stipend substitution.

academic.normalRoutes: Recognised bachelor normally second-class honours OR average B; accepted professional/similar bachelor-equivalent alternative; unusual lower grades require justification and assessment.

language.someElectives: Cantonese; sufficient English choices but more limited selection
language.centralDeliveryModes: TOEFL iBT/Home Edition and IELTS Academic centre/online; programme evidence still subject to acceptance
language.validity: TOEFL/IELTS two years from test; GMAT five, kept manual

cuhk.decision: Refresh this one parent only after reading all six sources; preserve stable offerings, dates, numerical thresholds and unresolved fees/academic policy. Clarify MA scope, material delivery, language and FAQ boundaries without creating admission gates.

hkust.decision: Both primary pages still support existing cohort/mode dates and prices. Do not rewrite unchanged evidence, copy September category rounds into February, import PGD or claim exact opening/time/live availability.
